name: LightRays-TS-TW
title: Light Rays
blurb: Light rays emanate from a direction with optional mouse tracking.
description: WebGL light rays originating from configurable edge with pointer-following. Supports color, speed, pulsation, and distortion parameters.
use_when: Hero backgrounds needing directional light effects with interactivity.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices; WebGL rendering is GPU-dependent and may be unavailable.
a11y: Decorative background. No keyboard or focus handling required.
